verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the Locations API doc. It says sellers can customize "the receipts issued for a location" with custom text "printed on receipts", which implies Square itself issues printed receipts, but only glancingly. Missing for 10: documentation of email or SMS digital receipt delivery, evidence that receipts meet card-network content requirements, details of how receipts are issued or printed, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can issue digital (email/SMS) or printed receipts that meet card-network requirements

citations.quote: A seller can customize the receipts issued for a location with two text fields. The `custom_receipt_text` field holds custom text that is printed on receipts
